title: profile_sync audit event payload
description: Payload passed as the `parameters` argument of AuditService.log_operation(operation="profile_sync") for each mutation the startup registry sync performs on agent_profiles (design D2), landing in the audit_log.parameters JSONB column (migration 008). One event per mutated row; unchanged rows emit nothing.

action.description: insert: row created for a registry agent; update: drifted fields reconciled to registry values; disable: enabled orphan row set enabled=false

source.description: Projection source; fixed until later roadmap phases introduce others

changed_fields.description: Present for action=update: field -> {from, to} pairs limited to trust_level, allowed_operations, enabled

trust_level.description: Declared trust level for insert/update actions
